source.author: verg
source.text: Hic aliud maius miseris multoque tremendum obicitur magis, atque improvida pectora turbat.
source.text_original: Hic aliud maius miseris multoque tremendum / obicitur magis, atque improvida pectora turbat.
source.text_english: Here another thing, greater and much more dreadful, is thrown in before the wretched, and it troubles their unthinking hearts much more.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illis placidi sermonis Iason suggerit affatus turbataque pectora mulcet.
reuse.text_original: illis placidi sermonis Iason / suggerit affatus turbataque pectora mulcet.
reuse.text_english: Jason supplies them with words of calm speech and soothes their troubled hearts.
